company.name: Qruz
company.shortDescription: Qruz is a tech-based, clean energy, mobility solution that offers premium services via a mobile application, and a web solution.
company.description:
Qruz is a technology-based transportation solution that offers a variety of mass transportation services assisted and enhanced by mobile applications, and web solutions, creating immense value to all our partners, and leading their operations into the 2020s, where technology is key, automation is crucial, and supervision is power. All of this is powered by an intuitive user experience that is in line with the latest trends and technologies.

Our LLC is based in Cairo, Egypt, and Alexandria operating in both major cities.

With a diverse revenue streams, and a wide array of services Qruz is poised to maximize it's per unit potential and achieve profitability with ease. With Qruz To Services(Qruz to Work and Qruz to School), Qruz On Demand, Qruz B2B Fleet Management, Qruz Seats, and Qruz Portable Ads all available to paying customer, and achieving proper traction.

Our company builds and owns its technology products, and systems to manage, and operate large scale, regional operations, and continuously works towards being market leaders in transportation and logistics tech.  

Qruz has just laid the groundwork for an unprecedented market disruption in the transport-tech sector in the MENA region. 

Last but not least, Qruz has its eyes on the future of transportation; Electrically Powered - Zero Emission Mass Transportation.
